cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Předmět je ukončen zápočtem a zkouškou. Pro získání zápočtu zpracovat a ve stanoveném termínu odevzdat a obhájit semestrální práci, dále pak úspěšně absolvovat zápočtovou písemnou práci. V daných souvislostech je nutno respektovat termíny a místa konání stanovená vyučujícím. Minimální bodový zisk pro získání zápočtu je stanoven na 30 bodů. Zkouška má písemnou podobu, kdy v případě hraničních výsledků, tj. celkový bodový zisk nižší než 67 bodů, je povinná taktéž ústní část zkoušky. Povinnost účasti na ústní části zkoušky je stanovena také v případě neúspěšné obhajoby semestrální práce s nutností jejího přepracování. Studentům kombinované formy studia se povinnost úspěšného složení samostatné zápočtové písemné práce nestanovuje. Výsledné hodnocení předmětu zohledňuje celkově dosažené body při získávání zápočtu a body ze zkoušky a je následující: stupeň A: více než 89 bodů, stupeň B: 83 - 89 bodů, stupeň C: 75 - 82 bodů, stupeň D: 68 - 74 bodů, stupeň E: 60 - 67 bodů, stupeň F: méně než 60 bodů. Předmět lze studovat i při vzdělávacím pobytu v zahraničí, kdy student musí vyhovět všem výše uvedeným podmínkám pro úspěšné ukončení předmětu v dohodnutých termínech s vyučujícím.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to make students familiar with methods of optimization of business processes based on economic analysis and reengineering, i. e. within the framework of setting up procedures, competences and responsibility for respective processional elements, measurement of resources' demandingness of business processes, outcomes of defined processes, prediction of internal demand for processional activities and the potential utilisation of IT and business information systems within the mentioned framework.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Economic analysis as the constituent of management of business entities. Premises and theoretical bases of management of changes and innovations. (allowance 3/1)2.Evaluation of economic effectiveness of changes within a business entity. (allowance 3/2) a.Selection and determination of basic economic criterions for measuring the effectiveness of processes of changes.b.Methods for evaluation of effectiveness of changes in a business entity.3.Reengineering as the tool for changes and innovations within the management of business entities. (allowance 2/0) a.Functional vs. processional management of business entity.b.Methods of business processes' reengineering.4.Economic aspects of risk related to changes and innovations. (allowance 4/2) a.Premises and identification of risk within this problem area.b.Management of risk - Enterprise Risk Management (ERM).5.Management of the change and risk within the current business entity. (allowance 4/2) a.Methods of production programmes' analysis.b.Comparison of business entities.c.Methods for planning new products and production programmes.6.Planning of inputs and outputs within processes of change and innovations. (allowance 4/2) a.Strategic management of processes of change in a business entity oriented for growth of its value.b.System of budgeting.c.Formation of the budget on basis of planned process performance.7.Analytical indicators of the partial factors of production productivity. (allowance 4/2) a.Analytical indicators of the partial factors of production productivity.b.Labour, wages and productivity of labour. Relation between average wages and labour productivity.8.Analysis of deviations within the business processes' framework. (allowance 2/2) a.Measurement of real utilisation of resources.b.Analysis of required and real utilisation of production capacities.9.Business information systems, technologies and their task within the framework of changes and innovations. (allowance 2/1) a.Basic premises of successful implementation of business information systems.b.Evolution of enterprising utilising electronic business, models of e-commerce.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Study of the subject is finalised with the preliminary and final-exam test. In order to successfully pass the preliminary, students have to pass the preliminary test and successfully defeat the assignment. It is required to gain at least 30 points in order to obtain the preliminary. The final exam is written and in the case of marginal results, i.e. less than totally 67 points, it has an obligatory oral part, including the case of not successfully defeated assignment. Students in a distance form do not have an individual preliminary test condition. The overall assessment and awarding the grade is based on overall points gained within preliminary and final examination as following: grade A: more than 89 points, grade B: 83 - 89 points, grade C: 75 - 82 points, grade D: 68 - 74 points, grade E: 60 - 67 points, grade F: less than 60 points. It is allowed to study this subject during studying abroad, while students have to fulfil all requirements and set terms.
